configure_mask_rcnn_xcit: configure a mask r-cnn model with xcit tiny backbone for instance segmentation on coco dataset
build_train_pipeline: build a training data pipeline with autoaugment, random flip, resize, normalize and pad for instance segmentation
configure_optimizer: configure an adamw optimizer with lr 0.0001, weight decay 0.05 and custom decay keys for absolute pos embed and norm
setup_training_schedule: setup a 36 epoch epoch-based training schedule with fp16 and lr steps at epochs 27 and 33
define_model_architecture: define a mask r-cnn model with xcit p8 backbone, single roi extractor and standard roi head for instance segmentation
